# Reviewed Android Snes9x cores

Unmodified Libretro Snes9x `1.63 fae2fea` builds for user-initiated rooted SNES
setup. Downloads use this repository's immutable artifact commit; these archives
are excluded from Flutter assets. Do not replace these versioned bytes.

[provenance.json](provenance.json) records original Buildbot URLs, capture date,
archive and payload hashes, verified ELF architectures and corresponding source.
The [exact source archive](https://codeload.github.com/libretro/snes9x/tar.gz/fae2fea08f74180759ef540ee94259213f503480) includes third-party notices and the
[Android build recipe](https://github.com/libretro/snes9x/blob/fae2fea08f74180759ef540ee94259213f503480/libretro/jni/Android.mk).
These are upstream binaries, not a claim of a reproduced toolchain build.

Snes9x is licensed for personal, noncommercial use; see the complete [LICENSE](LICENSE).
Its source also contains the JMA, snes_ntsc and xBRZ notices named by that license.
Broomm does not modify the binaries or their corresponding source.
